dialog.moveWindow: Accessible label of the grip that lets a dialog be dragged around.
dialog.moveHint: Keyboard and mouse instructions for moving and resizing a dialog window. Keep the key names Shift and Home.
dialog.rename: Confirm button of a rename prompt.
dialog.create: Confirm button of a prompt that creates something.
dialog.getDesktopApp: Link or button that leads to the download page of the desktop app.
dialog.copy: Button that copies text to the clipboard.
dialog.copied: The same button right after the copy worked.
dialog.close: Button that closes a dialog. Verb.
dialog.save: Button that saves the changes made in a dialog. Verb.
dialog.resizePanel: Accessible label of the drag handle on the edge of a side pane (Flows step panel, GraphQL and MCP panes, dialog lists). It is moved with the mouse or the arrow keys.
